# MySurgery — Healthcare Surgery Facilitation, Delhi-NCR, India

## Who We Are
MySurgery is a surgical care facilitation company based in Gurugram, Haryana, India.
We connect patients with expert surgeons and NABH-accredited hospitals across Delhi-NCR.
We are NOT a hospital. We are a patient-side coordinator that helps patients access
the right surgeon, navigate insurance, and manage their surgical journey end-to-end.

## Cities We Operate In
- Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana
- Delhi (NCR)
- Noida, Uttar Pradesh
- Faridabad, Haryana

## Procedures We Facilitate
- Piles Laser Treatment — Rs 40000 to Rs 80000 — same-day discharge
- Hernia Repair (Laparoscopic) — Rs 45000 to Rs 120000 — 1 night or same-day
- Gallbladder Removal (Laparoscopic) — Rs 50000 to Rs 90000 — same-day or 1 night
- Knee Replacement Surgery — Rs 150000 to Rs 350000 — 3 to 5 days
- Cataract Surgery — Rs 25000 to Rs 60000 per eye — same-day, no admission

## What We Offer
- Free surgical consultation — callback within 30 minutes
- Match patients with specialist surgeons
- Insurance pre-authorisation and cashless claims support
- Appointment scheduling and care coordination
- Post-operative follow-up support
- Transparent cost estimates before surgery

## Partner Hospitals
- Narayana Hospital Gurugram
- Medanta The Medicity Gurugram
- Fortis Memorial Research Institute Gurugram
- Apollo Miracle Gurugram
- Apollo Hospital Delhi
- Max Super Speciality Hospital Delhi
- Fortis Vasant Kunj Delhi
- Jaypee Hospital Noida
- Sarvodaya Hospital Faridabad
